categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong High Dream Intellectualized Machinery Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of automatic weighing instruments. Its main products include microcomputer combination scales, loss-in-weight feeders, inspection equipment, and related accessories. The company serves industries such as food, pharmaceuticals, plastics, and water supply with automated weighing, metering, and continuous batching solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company integrates software technology, precision mechanical manufacturing, and electrical control in its production processes. It emphasizes innovation with a comprehensive R&D system, holding 155 patents including invention patents and software copyrights. Production follows an order-assembly model, with a focus on high-end intelligent weighing instruments and customized product development to meet specific client needs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are from diverse sectors including food processing, pharmaceuticals, plastics, and water utilities. The company targets both domestic and international markets, with a significant portion of sales exported. It maintains strong partnerships with leading clients and aims to expand its presence in high-end market segments by offering differentiated and customized solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Foshan, Guangdong Province. It has subsidiaries in Taiwan and Germany, serving both domestic and overseas markets. Approximately 60% of revenue is generated domestically, while 40% comes from international sales, reflecting a balanced geographic footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong High Dream operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembling automated weighing and batching equipment. It sources raw materials such as metals and electronic components and delivers finished products and integrated solutions to downstream industrial customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D investment to enhance product quality and expand its product portfolio. It focuses on developing high-end intelligent weighing instruments, customized solutions, and new technologies such as IoT-enabled water meters and advanced packaging machines. Strengthening R&D teams and integrating resources across subsidiaries are key strategic initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of products including weighing instruments, inspection devices, and accessories. The company also earns income from leasing equipment and other business activities. Sales are conducted via direct sales channels and distributors, with a majority of revenue from product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic provider capable of delivering dynamic combination weighing and continuous automatic batching system solutions. It holds a strong market position with recognized brands such as 'High Dream' and 'Guangdong Anben'. Its products are considered cost-effective alternatives to imported equipment, competing on price and performance with international peers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 236.4 million, a 4.85% increase over the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 47.8 million, up 32.18%. The company maintains a solid asset base of about RMB 647 million and continues to grow steadily with improving profitability and cash flow generation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-performance, cost-effective automated weighing solutions with strong customization capabilities to meet diverse industry needs. Its competitive advantages include a robust patent portfolio, integrated R&D and manufacturing capabilities, and recognized domestic brands. The products provide reliable alternatives to imported equipment, emphasizing precision, stability, and comprehensive after-sales service.
